name: Hidden costs of the usual option

sections.hero: Dek: the usual option costs more than its sticker price.
sections.items: Each item is one cost of the usual option the reader overlooks.
sections.faq: Answer the cost questions with verified prices only.
sections.closing: End on the product as the clear alternative, with verified price, delivery and warranty facts.

items.heading_hint: Recurring fees that add up -- an ad speaker's own estimate only as an attributed line
Paying again for extras sold separately
Cheap options that cost more later (install, terms)
The product as the one-time alternative, with verified facts

voice: Plain math, second person, short sentences; no scare framing.
compliance: Every number, price, spec or outcome needs a verified claim_id; a hint is never a fact.
No health or outcome promise for the product; a health statement cites the study and its population.
An ad speaker's cost estimate is an attributed line only, never a heading, bullet or FAQ answer.
No savings figure or payback period unless a verified claim states it.
writer_brief: Number the costs the usual option hides. Keep the math honest and attributed. End on the verified alternative, not a savings calculator.
